detail: The latest zero-transport preflight candidate and formal evidence are explicitly withdrawn after independent review found four N1-validator authority gaps: the runtime source card was not an exact directive closure, schema and whitelist inputs could be self-signed substitutes, canonical whitelist/classification identity was not joined, and commit identity was not pinned to the planned job metadata. Remediation is limited to those strict authority joins, hostile fixtures, formal nontransport tests, and a fresh write-once preflight. The matrix remains 448 planned jobs and zero runnable jobs. P12 remains blocked pending a separately authorized 672-event installed plain-versus-preload sentinel; P20 remains blocked because no independently reviewed full-smoke runner, executable statistics implementation, or one-shot scheduler/token exists. No Cosima, m05cosima, EventList, or Geant4 transport has been launched, and no authorization token has been created or consumed.
